posts.title: Making of the tidal canal, second half
posts.description: The tidal canal was meant to be important, and there was much angst in its making. The canal crossed a peninsula and turned Alameda into the Island City. By the time it was finished, it wasn’t needed but was still hotly desired. Today it’s just there. The canal was a key part of Oakland’s great […]
